nls.series: Ordnance Survey, London 1:1056, surveyed 1862-74, single sheets through IIIF (decision of Cristian, 2026-10-18: not the tile bucket)
nls.credit: Reproduced with the permission of the National Library of Scotland, https://maps.nls.uk/
nls.use: Only the anchors and named sites of overrides.json are read on the sheets; water and streets come from OHM. The georeferenced sheets and the comparison image come with the tools of issue #170.
nls.gap: The north-west corner (cells x 0-5, y 0-3) falls on sheet VII.77, which has no 1862-74 edition: only the OHM streets there, and the land stays free (option A, decision of Cristian, 2026-10-18).
